name: Mohammad Haseeb
bio: Brings sales and daily operations together, keeping the property search, paperwork and handover moving in one direction. His focus is simple: a clear next step for every client and a team that follows through.

name: Mohd Shahid Khan
bio: Keeps office operations running smoothly while managing the company's IT systems and digital infrastructure. Coordinates administrative processes, streamlines workflows and provides reliable technical support.

name: Issaadi Chahrazed
bio: Specializes in Dubai's off-plan properties, helping clients identify high-potential investment opportunities. Provides expert advice on new launches, payment plans, and market trends to help buyers make confident decisions.

name: Talha Shabbir
bio: Is the first conversation behind new relationships at SWK. Turns a broad property brief into a practical discussion about location, budget and timing, then connects clients with the right consultant.

name: Fareed Choudhary
bio: Helps buyers look beyond a striking photograph to how a home will actually work: layout, neighbourhood and ongoing costs. Supports clients through shortlisting, viewings and the steps toward purchase.
